fusions.name: Leg-Iron Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes out on the chain bound to your leg for 12 damage, up to 1.6 times that at its full 6 tiles, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it moving 20% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Flock Shackle
fusions.desc: Whips a length of links in a ring around you, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3 tiles; the blow leaps on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Short Leash
fusions.desc: Drags up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tethered Pullet
fusions.desc: A pullet on a chain runs at your heel, pecking enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it pecks moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
